== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of [[Passage To The Alderaan System]] (Original text), as published: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/335d47f6b929debedbac9376b863af4442469f36/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/passagetothealderaansystem.gif Holotable image repository, commit 335d47f] “Set 23 new images”, 20 July 2024. Uploaded unchanged (byte-for-byte copy of that commit's file; the PC stores it as PNG data under a .gif name, so it is uploaded here with a .png extension). Later replaced at the same address by the next version's image.

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-3/36/V23-L-passagetothealderaansystem-original.png Internet Archive item].
